experiment: E1 baselines / matched-FA comparison (IEEE Access revision, R2-4, R3)
written: 2026-11-13, before the full calibration/validation/evaluation run (a 10%-scale timing pilot with role='pilot' streams, disjoint from all reported streams, was run first; its numbers are not reported)
resumed_note: Experiment started 2026-11-11 by a previous agent (WindowLR kernel + validation only). WindowLR code reviewed on 2026-11-13: no defects found; reused unchanged. Validation vs naive O(n^2) reference: exp_E1/winlr_validation.json (max abs path error 0, 38,737 values, constant d=0/500 and geometric delays, first crossings and restart counts).

seeding.note: independent streams for every (stage, null path, harmful condition); CRN across monitors within a batch

model.extras: no label noise, no board/Markov effects

grid.null_settings: 24 = pi x q x d (thresholds do not depend on r1)

stream_counts.arl_restart: first 2,500 validation streams under constant 0.10 (horizon H, restart after alarm, threshold h_hi without randomization)
stream_counts.budget_decision: pilot projected < 2 h total at 4 threads, so no reduction of calibration streams for supplement monitors

calibration.rule: h* = stricter of h_const (FA 0.02 over H at constant r=0.10) and h_path (FA 0.02 under 0.05->0.10 at tau); calibrate_threshold(method='randomized', tol=1e-9) on per-stream maxima; stricter = larger h, tie -> smaller gamma

validation.statistic: any alarm within 1..H, randomized rule with the stream's tiebreak uniform
validation.gate: one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson upper bound, Bonferroni over the primary family, <= 0.03
validation.primary_family: 12 core matched monitors x 24 null settings x 2 gated paths (const10, path) = 576
validation.non_primary: supplement/native/const-calibrated variants are reported with the same CP bounds but are outside the gated family

core_matched.winlr_D10000: NEW window LR scan: LLR(r1=0.20 vs 0.10) over arrived labels with origin in [t-D+1, t], D=10,000
core_matched.periodic: periodic exact binomial (interval 3000), calibrated threshold on -log p

supplement_matched.cs_detector: CSDetector (own instantiation of backward CS, see library docstring)

constant_null_calibrated_spec_violation.adwin_constcal: calibrated on constant 0.10 only; FA on 0.05->0.10 path reported

metrics.p_D: P(tau <= T <= tau+D-1), all streams in denominator, exact CP 95% two-sided CI
metrics.restricted_mean_delay: mean of (T - tau) if timely by D, else D; early alarms are assigned D (counted as failures) and reported separately
metrics.delay_quantiles: median and 90% quantile of T - tau among timely detections (inverted CDF), per D
metrics.arl: false alarms per 10,000 items under constant 0.10 with restart (supplement)
metrics.oracle: beta*(0.02) = theory/converse.np_power(L=max(0,D-d), rho=pi*q, r0=0.10, r1, alpha=0.02); ratio p_D/beta*
metrics.oracle_exceedance_check: flag any (monitor, condition, D) whose two-sided 95% CP lower bound of p_D exceeds beta*; any flag -> investigate FA validity
metrics.cusum_sanity: MC p_D of cusum_0.20 vs exact DP of the integer CUSUM (theory/exact_cusum.py, scale_B=80) with exact randomized composite calibration at 0.02, all 72 conditions x 3 deadlines; report z-scores
metrics.tradeoff: 4 conditions (pi,r1,q,d) = (0.1,0.2,0.2,500), (0.1,0.12,1,500), (0.01,0.3,1,0), (0.1,0.3,0.1,500); strict thresholds from the union of 120-level null-maxima quantile grids of both gated paths (validation streams); FA_comp = max(FA_const10, FA_path) on validation streams; p_D on evaluation streams; summary p_D at FA_comp <= {0.005, 0.01, 0.02, 0.05}

summaries.q_min: for each monitor and scenario (pi, r1, d), smallest evaluated q with point p_D(10k) >= 0.80 (also reported: smallest q whose CP lower bound >= 0.80); compared with q_oracle and q_cusum from theory/qstar_grid.csv
summaries.ranking: per harmful condition at D=10k, rank core matched monitors by p_D (average ranks for ties); report mean rank, number of conditions where each is best or within 0.01 of best, and Kendall's W across the conditions where not all monitors have p_D in {0,1}
summaries.post_hoc: anything not listed here is labelled post hoc in REPORT.md

amendment_2026-11-13.label: POST HOC / FOLLOW-UP (written 2026-11-13 after the primary run and external Codex review, BEFORE running these analyses)

A1_gate_repair.procedure: for each failed monitor x setting: recalibrate (same composite randomized rule, target 0.02) on 100,000 fresh calibration streams per null path (role calibration, condition ids 3000+4*setting+path); revalidate on 10,000 fresh validation streams per path (role validation, ids 3100+4*setting+path); gate unchanged (one-sided CP upper, Bonferroni family 576, <= 0.03); re-evaluate the 3 harmful conditions of that setting on the ORIGINAL evaluation streams (same ids, CRN with other monitors). Original results kept; repaired results in *_repair.csv. If a repaired cell still fails, it is reported as 'not certified' and excluded from confirmatory rankings.

A2_crn_paired.label: exploratory (no multiplicity adjustment)
A2_crn_paired.statistic: difference in timely-detection indicator on the same evaluation streams (CRN), mean and 95% normal CI from paired SD; also exact McNemar p-value

A3_fine_q.streams: cal 20,000 / val 10,000 per path / eval 10,000 (same rules as primary)
A3_fine_q.q_min: linear interpolation of p_D(10k) in log q across all evaluated q (original + fine) at 0.80; CI: q where the CP upper curve crosses 0.80 (lower end) and where the CP lower curve crosses 0.80 (upper end); non-monotone crossings reported

amendment_2026-11-13.A4_figures: trade-off curves (4 conditions), p_D vs q with oracle beta* (incl. fine grid), timely-delay distributions; PNG+PDF in figures/
amendment_2026-11-13.A5_reporting: rank summaries with and without DDM (DDM reported as infeasible under this protocol); restart metric renamed 'restart false-alarm incidence' (per 10,000 items)

amendment_2026-11-13b.label: FOLLOW-UP, CONFIRMATORY VERSION (decided by lead 2026-11-13 after observing 20k-calibration gate failures; written BEFORE running). Uniform re-run, not selective repair; original 20k results and the selective repair (amendment_2026-11-13 A1) are kept as reported history.
amendment_2026-11-13b.calibration: 100,000 fresh calibration streams per null path (const 0.10 and 0.05->0.10) for EVERY monitor x setting, same composite randomized rule, target 0.02
amendment_2026-11-13b.validation: 10,000 fresh independent validation streams per path (const10, path, const05); gate one-sided 95% CP upper <= 0.03, Bonferroni family = 12 core x 24 main settings x 2 paths (576) + 12 core x 18 fine-q settings x 2 paths (432) = 1008

ids.main: calibration role ids 6000+4*setting+path, validation role ids 6100+4*setting+path; evaluation = SAME ids as primary (500+3*setting+r1 index), i.e. identical CRN evaluation streams
ids.fine_q: calibration ids 7000+4*j+path, validation ids 7100+4*j+path; evaluation same as amendment A3 (4500+j)

amendment_2026-11-13b.scope: all monitors/variants of the primary run (core, supplement, native, const-calibrated) for the main grid; core 12 for fine-q grid
amendment_2026-11-13b.rules: cells failing the gate under 100k are reported as uncertified and excluded from confirmatory rankings; no further repair
amendment_2026-11-13b.comparison: report gate pass count, max upper bound, max |delta p_D| vs 20k version, rank changes and q_min changes
